entities.summary: Egor Yurievich Afanasyev is a Russian professional ice hockey winger currently playing for the San Jose Barracuda in the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the second round of the 2019 NHL entry draft, 45th overall, by the Nashville Predators.
